Guam Code Annotated title 11, chapter 26 (Business Privilege Tax Law) — 5% on gross proceeds of sales and gross income, in force since 1 October 2018 (Public Law 34-116)
Guam Department of Revenue and Taxation, Director's Announcement 18-05: Business Privilege Tax at 5 percent (extended from 1 October 2018, continuing indefinitely)

caveats: individualTaxYear is the calendar year, inferred from the country's annual assessment cycle (grade I); not confirmed on the authority's own pages in this pass.
companyYearEndDefault is a 31 December app default for new entities (grade I), not a statutory requirement; companies may choose other year ends under national law.

Guam's BPT is a gross receipts tax rather than a sales tax: 5% since 1 October 2018 (8% on poker machines and 12% on boxing events). Some secondary tables record lower wholesale-activity rates; the 5% general rate is statutory.
